messages:
maria: Quick async check — incremental rollout for feature_flag=fastpath starts now. I'm opening slice A at 1%.
jon: on it, watching alerts and traces :eyes:
kevin: did the canary config get the traffic annotation? pinging @maria
maria: yes, config pushed. snippet:
```
routes:
  - name: fastpath
    slices:
      - id: A
        pct: 1
        annotations: ["latency-sensitive"]
```
kevin: thanks, saw the config. I'll bump log sampling for that route.
sara: FYI product is running smoke tests against slice A now — link: https://internal/e2e/fastpath/1
product-ana: tests passed for baseline scenarios, sending the validation doc in case anyone wants results.
ops-bot: Alert rule "p95_token_latency" configured to 2s. Will notify if breach occurs.
jon: small blocker — unclear if fallback model is wired for this flag. kevin can you confirm?
kevin: confirmed fallback is wired to model-v2-fallback. I pushed a small hotfix to runtime mapping, CR #452 pending review.
maria: thanks. @kevin can you post CR link here once ready? we'll hold delta to 5% until CR lands.
kevin: CR posted: https://code/repo/CR/452 — requesting quick review from @jon and @sara
jon: reviewing now, should be fine. if green, we can go to 5% in 20m.
sara: monitoring dashboards up. if anything spikes I'll call in the oncall.
maria: plan for next 2 hours: 1% -> 5% after CR merge, run through targeted prompts from QA, then 20% if stable. anyone object?
product-ana: sounds good. we'll target the regression suite at 5% and report back by T+40m.
deploy-bot: canary promotion queued: from 1% to 5% pending status checks.
jon: merged CR, CI green. promote when ready.
maria: promoting now.
deploy-bot: promotion started — updating slices: A=5%.
ops-bot: p95 latency for fastpath at 1.4s (baseline 1.3s) — within threshold.
kevin: tiny spike in memory on a single host, investigating thread leaks.
maria: if it looks like a host-level issue, we can exclude that host from slice until fix. keep me posted.
kevin: will do, opening a quick ticket.
product-ana: QA running regression pass at 5% — will post failures if any.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll post a brief summary after we hit 20% or if any major flags pop. :thumbsup:
